bank.question: Statement: Which of these driver types is legally required to complete a tax check when renewing their licence — HGV delivery drivers.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: Private hire vehicle (PHV) drivers. Private hire vehicle (PHV) drivers (and operators) are one of the three main groups required to complete the tax check when renewing

bank.question: Statement: What security credential is required to log in and complete the tax check on GOV.UK — A Government Gateway user ID and password.
bank.explanation: The Government Gateway ID is the standard secure login used to access most HMRC digital services, including the tax check

bank.question: Statement: How long is a tax check code valid for once it has been generated — 30 days.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: 120 days. The tax check code is valid for 120 days from the date it is generated. If it expires before you provide it to the licensing authority, you must generate a new one

bank.question: Statement: Which of the following must a driver report as income on their tax return — Total earnings from all licensed activities, regardless of how they were paid.
bank.explanation: Drivers must declare all income from relevant licensed activities, including cash, app-based payments, and account work

bank.question: Statement: What should a driver do if they have been working but have never told HMRC about their income — Wait for HMRC to contact you first.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: Make a voluntary disclosure to HMRC. If you missed several years of tax, you should contact HMRC as soon as possible to make a voluntary disclosure and settle your affairs

bank.question: Statement: Which of the following non-transport licenses also requires a tax check under the current HMRC rules — Scrap metal site license.
bank.explanation: Operating a scrap metal site requires a tax check in the same way that taxi and private hire licenses do

bank.question: Statement: What is one of the primary reasons the UK government introduced 'tax conditionality' for these licenses — To increase the cost of getting a taxi license.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: To level the playing field and tackle the 'hidden economy'. This policy was introduced to level the playing field, ensuring all businesses pay the tax they owe, which prevents dishonest businesses from undercutting compliant ones

bank.question: Statement: What is the 'first-time applicant' requirement for a licensing authority — Direct the applicant to HMRC guidance on their tax obligations.
bank.explanation: Applicants who are not yet registered for tax or are applying for their first licence are directed to guidance on tax obligations instead of a tax check

bank.question: Statement: What is the main objective of 'tax conditionality' in the licensing process — To increase the cost of local authority licenses.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: To ensure everyone is playing by the same rules and paying the tax they owe. Tax conditionality is designed to prevent 'ghosting' or operating in the hidden economy by ensuring license holders are correctly registered for tax

bank.question: Statement: How long is an HMRC tax check code valid for once it has been generated — 120 days.
bank.explanation: A tax check code is valid for 120 days from the date it is generated. If it expires before the licence application is processed, a new code must be obtained

bank.question: Statement: What is the maximum amount of self-employment income a driver can earn in a tax year before they MUST register for Self Assessment — £5,000.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: £1,000. Under the Trading Allowance, you can earn up to £1,000 from self-employment each tax year without needing to inform HMRC or pay tax on it

bank.question: Statement: If an applicant cannot use the online GOV.UK service to complete a tax check, whom should they contact for assistance — The HMRC tax check helpline.
bank.explanation: While most people use the digital service, HMRC provides a telephone helpline for those who are 'digitally excluded' or unable to use online services

bank.question: Statement: The tax check requirement was extended to licensing authorities in Scotland and Northern Ireland on which date — 1 April 2022.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: 2 October 2023. The rules were extended to Scotland and Northern Ireland from 2 October 2023

bank.question: Statement: What is the most likely consequence of failing to provide a tax check code when applying to renew a licence — The licensing authority cannot renew your licence, meaning you cannot work.
bank.explanation: The licensing authority cannot grant a renewal until the tax check is completed, meaning your licence could expire and you would be unable to work legally

bank.question: Statement: When is an applicant required to complete a formal tax check rather than just reading HMRC's tax guidance — When applying for their first-ever license in the industry.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: When renewing an existing license or applying for a similar one held in the last year. A tax check is required when renewing a license or when applying for a new license that is the same as one held within the last 12 months

bank.question: Statement: When an authority verifies a tax check code, what information do they actually see regarding the applicant's taxes — Whether the applicant completed the check, but no financial or tax data.
bank.explanation: Licensing authorities only receive confirmation that the check was completed; they do not see any specific financial figures

bank.question: Statement: How long is a tax check code valid for — 7 days.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: 120 days. Tax check codes are valid for 120 days

bank.question: Statement: In the context of the tax check, what is meant by a 'first-time' applicant — An applicant applying for a specific licence for the very first time.
bank.explanation: A 'first-time' applicant is someone who has never held a licence for that specific activity before or whose previous licence expired more than a year ago

bank.question: Statement: What is a licensing authority's legal obligation if the applicant provides an invalid or expired tax check code — They can grant a temporary 30-day license while waiting.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: They cannot grant the license renewal until the check is verified. Licensing authorities cannot proceed with a renewal application until they have received and successfully verified a valid tax check code via the HMRC portal

bank.question: Statement: What exactly does the HMRC tax check verify about an applicant's status — Being registered for tax on the income earned from that licensed activity.
bank.explanation: The tax check confirms specific tax registration, such as having a Self Assessment record or a Corporation Tax record

bank.question: Statement: Which of the following professional licences does NOT require an HMRC tax check for renewal — Private hire vehicle (PHV) operator.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: Courier or delivery van driver hub. The tax check covers licenses for driving taxis or PHVs, operating a PHV business, and dealing in scrap metal. Courier services are not currently part of this specific tax conditionality rule

bank.question: Statement: If an applicant cannot use the online tax check service due to a lack of digital skills, how can they complete the check — By calling HMRC's helpline if they cannot use the online service.
bank.explanation: While most use the online Government Gateway, those who are digitally excluded can complete the check over the phone with HMRC

bank.question: Statement: What is the primary method for a driver to sign in to the tax check service on GOV.UK — NI Number and date of birth only.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: Government Gateway user ID and password. The Government Gateway ID is the standard secure login used to access all HMRC digital services, including the tax check

bank.question: Statement: When completing a tax check, what must an applicant confirm regarding their previous income — Whether they have reported their income from the licensed activity in a previous tax return.
bank.explanation: Applicants should confirm they have reported their income for the most recent tax year for which a return was due

bank.question: Statement: An applicant must complete a tax check if they are applying for a new license that is the same as one they held previously, but which expired — Less than 2 years ago.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: Less than 12 months ago. A person is considered to be 'renewing' a license if they already hold a valid license for the same activity or held one that expired less than a year ago

bank.question: Statement: How many characters long is the tax check code provided by HMRC — 9 characters.
bank.explanation: A tax check code consists of 9 characters, including both letters and numbers, and is case-sensitive

bank.question: Statement: To complete the tax check, what must a self-employed driver be registered for with HMRC — VAT registration.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: Self Assessment registration. If a driver is self-employed, they must be registered for Self Assessment to successfully complete the tax check. HMRC will verify that the income from the trade has been reported

bank.question: Statement: How long is a tax check code valid for once it has been generated by HMRC — 120 days.
bank.explanation: A tax check code is specifically designed for one application and remains valid for 120 days from the date it is generated

bank.question: Statement: What information does HMRC share with the licensing authority after you complete a tax check — How much tax you paid last year.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: Whether you have completed the tax check correctly. HMRC does not share your actual financial data or tax calculations with the licensing body; they only confirm that the check was completed

bank.question: Statement: If an applicant is renewing both a scrap metal dealer license and a taxi driver license, how do they handle the tax check — They must complete a separate tax check for each license type.
bank.explanation: A separate tax check code must be generated for each distinct license type being applied for

bank.question: Statement: If a driver does not have a Government Gateway account, what must they do to start their tax check online — Apply for a new Passport.
bank.explanation: The correct answer is: Create a Government Gateway user ID. If a driver has a Government Gateway user ID, they should use it; if they don't, they must create one to access the tax check service
